title: Beyond the Benchmark: Conditioning, Domains and Failure Modes of Qwen3-TTS
abstract: arXiv:2610.23678v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Qwen3-TTS reports state-of-the-art zero-shot voice cloning, but its technical report leaves open how the model should be conditioned, how it behaves outside read speech, and how it fails. We characterise its two cloning interfaces, in-context learning (ICL) and X-Vector, against Chatterbox, XTTS-v2 and F5-TTS on read, meeting, emotional and air-traffic-control (ATC) speech, using eighteen objective measures, an LLM judge, a spoofing countermeasure and a listening test. Neither interface dominates: ICL clones timbre more closely from correctly transcribed references, X-Vector clones timing, and ICL degrades sharply when a short reference transcript is wrong. Domain explains four times more variance than system choice. Qwen3-TTS leads on intelligibility and pitch register but trails on prosody, and the objective measures rank systems differently from listeners. An off-the-shelf countermeasure flags its clones no more often than genuine r

translated_title: 超越基准测试：Qwen3-TTS 的条件设置、语音领域与失效模式
translated_abstract: Qwen3-TTS 报告了最先进的零样本语音克隆能力，但其技术报告并未说明模型应如何进行条件设置、它在朗读语音之外的表现如何，以及它会如何失效。我们对其两种克隆接口——上下文学习（ICL）和 X-Vector——进行了系统表征，并与 Chatterbox、XTTS-v2 和 F5-TTS 在朗读、会议、情感和空中交通管制（ATC）语音上进行对比，使用了十八项客观指标、一个 LLM 评审、一种欺骗检测对抗措施以及一项听力测试。结果显示两种接口均无绝对优势：ICL 在参考音频转录正确时能更贴近地克隆音色，X-Vector 则更能克隆语音的时序节奏，而当较短的参考文本转录有误时，ICL 的表现会急剧下降。语音领域对结果方差的解释力是系统选择的四倍。Qwen3-TTS 在可懂度和音高区间上领先，但在韵律上落后，且客观指标对系统的排序与听者的主观评价并不一致。现成的欺骗检测对抗措施对其克隆语音的检出率并不高于对真实录音的检出率。
tldr: 该研究系统评估了 Qwen3-TTS 两种语音克隆接口在多种语音领域中的表现与失效模式，发现语音领域对结果的影响远大于系统选择，两种接口各有优劣，且客观指标与人类听感评价并不一致。
